spans.notes: Older Pudgy art style in an isometric cut-away: a glossy, shaded light-blue sofa seen from high above, floating on a flat cyan void, with thin dark-blue furniture outlines. The penguin looks like an earlier Polly design (pale pink body, three-strand tuft, bright yellow feet instead of orange), so identity is also unplaced (a U5-type question), but the drop stands on style alone. Action: she lies back on the sofa holding a phone to her ear and eating fish crackers from a bag on her belly, tosses a cracker up f25-40, then holds the phone in front of her face from ~f85; the bag tips and crackers spill to the floor from ~f110. Phone has two lenses and a logo, no tuft: not the iFin. Snack bag has printed text (in-world). No meme caption or watermark (scanned top 30% / bottom 20% of every frame: no dark pixels in this shot).
